ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 12, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  THE BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 3:00 PM

Barbara A. Pollack, Chair  Margo Morales, Commissioner
Chief Coleman, Vice Chair  J. P. Shotwell, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Susan Wise, Commissioner
Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54617  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meeting of
  Wednesday, February 12, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-54618  Recommendation to receive and file the Inaugural Annual Report of the Office of
  Ethics and Transparency.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-54619  Recommendation to receive and file, and if necessary, provide feedback to the
  Chair and Vice Chair on the Ethics Commission’s 2024 Annual Report draft.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-54620  Recommendation to solicit input for and authorize the Chair and Vice Chair to
  compose and submit a memorandum to the City Manager, Mayor and City Council,
  and Budget Oversight Committee regarding the Fiscal Year 2026 Budget and the
  Ethics Commission's budgetary requests and recommendations.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  THE BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 3:00 PM

5.  25-54621  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the implementation of the 5-
  Year Strategic Roadmap from the Office of Ethics and Transparency.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-54649  Recommendation to receive and file COI amendments (Harbor) from City Clerk.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-54622  Recommendation to receive and file, and if necessary, approve the final
  memorandum and draft Good Government Act ordinance recommendation from
  the Ad Hoc on Updated Policies to be sent to the City Council for consideration.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-54623  Recommendation to authorize the Ad Hoc on Updated Policies and former
  members of the Ad Hoc Committee on the Lobbyist Ordinance to appear at any
  future council meetings in which the Ethics Ordinance and changes to the Lobbyist
  Ordinance proposals are presented and discussed.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  25-54624  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Ad Hoc Committee on
  Commission Responsibilities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 25-54625  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming
  projects; and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 25-54626  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

12. 25-54627  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Commission
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
